provenance.basis: A lead is estimated to add 4% of current delivery capacity per month after recruitment and onboarding.
Each additional developer is estimated to add 3% of current delivery capacity per month within the three-month window after onboarding.
Existing mid-weight developers provide the current delivery capacity being increased.
A larger mid-weight team without senior leadership increases the leadership gap.
Better technical direction is provisionally estimated to improve three-month productivity by 0.15% of today's level per leadership-score point.
Additional effective delivery capacity is provisionally estimated to translate into 0.2% of today's productivity per capacity point by month three.
